agntz vision: orientation layer (agntz ctx) + unified agent surface, correlation via AGENT_CTX — DESIGN.md
description:
Make agntz worth using: stop being a pure delegator to mmry/trx/hstry/skdlr; become the agent's operative-memory front door. Vision is in DESIGN.md.

## Scope
1. **`agntz ctx` (flagship)** — one snapshot of what is relevant to the agent here and now: top memories for this repo, open/in-flight tasks, recent session history, upcoming schedule, optional `--gvnr` fleet view. Serves cold-start/re-entry/handoff/resume.
2. Read **AGENT_CTX** (VERSION/HARNESS/HARNESS_SESSION_ID/RUN_MODE/WORKSPACE_ID/MACHINE_ID/OS_ARCH + producer map) to know who/where we are; filter every store to that context. Works identically in bare pi / oqto-only / herdr / full.
3. **Unified agent surface** — consistent commands + flags, `--json` on every read, ONE MCP server / one tool spec, wrappers as backends.
4. **No bespoke correlation** — relation across tools is inherited from AGENT_CTX lineage stamping (session/workspace/machine id), not a separate graph.
5. Fold in existing trx: agntz-find (cross-tool search), agntz-tag (cross-tool tagging), agntz-pagv (--agent to mmry). Snapshot capture stays an explicit open design problem (see DESIGN.md).

## Positive-outcome proof (agent must run and show results)
1. In a herdr pane, `agntz ctx` prints a correct snapshot filtered by the current HERDR->AGENT_CTX session/workspace, without hardcoding harness.
2. Same binary works in bare-pi / non-herdr (AGENT_CTX from pi) with identical behavior.
3. `agntz <any> --json` returns stable machine-parseable JSON on every read verb.
4. The MCP server exposes one tool the agent loads (no five help texts).

See DESIGN.md (this repo). Relates to govnr ADR-0006 + role-split note; AGENT_CTX v2 (byteowlz pi-agent-extensions piext-wvx0).

title: Implement agntz find - unified cross-tool search
description: Add 'agntz find' command that searches across hstry, mmry, and trx simultaneously. Queries each tool's native interface with appropriate filters, merges results into a common format, and ranks by relevance + recency. Flags: --since (date range), --source mmry,hstry,trx (limit to specific tools), --tag (filter by tag where supported), --workspace (filter by workspace/repo), --limit, --json. Requires: standardized JSON output from all three tools (see trx issues in hstry/mmry/trx repos). Example: 'agntz find authentication --since 2w' searches all three tools for authentication-related content from the last 2 weeks.

title: Pass --agent to mmry when running inside an agent session
description: agntz memory add shells out to mmry without --agent, so all memories default to 'human (human)'. When running inside a Pi/agent session, agntz should detect the agent environment (e.g. PI_SESSION_ID env var) and pass --agent pi --agent-kind coding_agent to mmry.

title: Add agntz tag - cross-tool tagging
description: Add 'agntz tag' command that applies tags across tools. 'agntz tag authentication session-id-xyz' tags a hstry conversation. 'agntz tag authentication memory-id-xyz' tags a mmry memory. 'agntz tag authentication trx-abc' adds a label to a trx issue. Tags become the cross-tool connector (Pal pattern) that enables queries like 'everything tagged authentication'.
